prompt_size.qualification: Measured from local prompt_for in isolated candidate with frozen sources and no provider/controller ledger receipts. Actual run adds run binding/evidence and must be measured immediately pre-provider; model-token limits and provider-side envelope are not exposed by this local measurement.

safety_findings.evidence: The candidate mounts only the explicit host ~/.codex/auth.json into /worker-home/.codex/auth.json. Codex argv enables shell/tool execution (codex exec), sets approval never and sandbox read-only, but does not disable the shell tool. Codex read-only permits reading files; the mounted auth file is therefore potentially readable by model-invoked commands. No token was read.
safety_findings.resolution: Do not run Codex through this bootstrap until credentials are kept outside the command-visible filesystem (for example a separately reviewed credential broker or a supported no-tools review mode with provider authentication outside the worker).

safety_findings.evidence: Outer bubblewrap invocation uses shared network for inference; code reports network enabled with no destination firewall. Claude has tools/MCP disabled. Codex uses an inner read-only sandbox, but this invocation did not verify the effective network policy of child commands.
safety_findings.resolution: Keep this as unverified; require an enforceable egress allowlist or an externally controlled review path and verify effective Codex permissions before any provider call.

safety_findings.finding: Candidate CLI package needs a Git root
safety_findings.evidence: The isolated candidate directory has no .git; git rev-parse returns “not a git repository”. The workspace snapshot path calls git ls-files.
safety_findings.resolution: Prepare a fresh disposable bootstrap copy and initialize a local Git repository there; never initialize or write the operational repository.

safety_findings.evidence: The candidate execute path still sends council output through council_gate, which requires status approved/approved_with_conditions and implementation_allowed=true, even for a read_only plan.
safety_findings.resolution: Before bootstrap, demonstrate that this means only technical eligibility and cannot authorize integration; otherwise keep blocked or request a separately reviewed read-only gate contract.

safety_findings.finding: One review run is multiple model turns
safety_findings.evidence: Dual council policy includes independent proposal, cross-examination and defense. Default CallBudget permits up to six provider calls. Supervisor configuration may allow retries unless a run-local max_retries=0 is verified.
safety_findings.resolution: For a genuinely one-shot run, ensure the isolated run config allows no retries and cap the controller call budget to the intended council stages; do not alter global policy.

qa.mandatory: Before any council provider call, workspace central_qa uses network-disabled Bubblewrap and runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -v` against an offline synthetic project view.
qa.detail: La corrida conservada de 125 incluyó 113 pruebas unitarias y 12 de integración. central_qa repite las 113 unitarias de esa corrida y descubre además todas las demás tests/unit; no repite por sí mismo las 12 de integración.
